text: 金十数据10月7日讯，一份最新报告显示，尽管全球贸易面临关税、战争和地缘政治裂痕等多重压力，商品贸易仍表现出较强韧性。人工智能设备需求激增成为重要推动力量，同时美国与中国正在重新调整贸易关系，全球供应链也在适应新的贸易格局。由德国物流巨头DHL集团与纽约大学斯特恩商学院联合编制的《DHL全球化追踪》预计，今年全球商品贸易将增长4.6%，明显高于今年1月预测的3.6%。报告同时上调了明年的贸易增长预期，从此前预测的2.7%提高至3.6%。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 7 — A latest report shows that despite multiple pressures including tariffs, wars and geopolitical rifts facing global trade, goods trade has still shown strong resilience. Surging demand for AI equipment has become an important driving force, while the U.S. and China are readjusting their trade relationship, and global supply chains are adapting to the new trade landscape. The DHL Global Connectedness Tracker, jointly compiled by German logistics giant DHL Group and NYU Stern School of Business, estimates that global goods trade will grow 4.6% this year, significantly higher than the 3.6% forecast in January. The report also raised next year's trade growth forecast to 3.6% from a previous estimate of 2.7%.
